assumptions.statement: The repository provisional polygons are used only to organize a reviewable concept package; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive layers, drawings and metrics must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire safety and engineering constraints are not available in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: Land use, building, mobility and infrastructure moves are conceptual suggestions rather than approved controls or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: No verified parcel-level housing stock, rent, vacancy, tenure or talent-demand baseline was available.
assumptions.impact: The proposal defines service types and decision gates but does not claim a housing quantity, rent level or delivery commitment.

assumptions.statement: Childcare, education, health, culture and multilingual-service capacity has not been inventoried at facility level.
assumptions.impact: The three Living Yards are service prototypes whose locations and capacities require a public-facility survey and community consultation.

assumptions.statement: Complete heritage protection boundaries and construction-control zones for Jing-Zhang assets are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks use reversible, low-impact components and must be reviewed by heritage professionals before siting.

assumptions.statement: Talent services must not rank residents, infer sensitive traits, or make automated eligibility decisions.
assumptions.impact: Every AI scenario retains a staffed channel, a non-digital path, data minimization and a documented stop mechanism.
